target_pattern: Choose imperfect for background, description, age, time, and repeated past actions; choose preterite for completed events and interruptions; combine both to narrate natural past stories.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Using one generic past tense for everything and translating by vocabulary instead of event function.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish splits past meaning into scene/background (imperfect) and completed events or interruptions (preterite). Pick tense by role in the story.
target_pattern_formula: single completed event with clear boundary -> preterite
ongoing past interrupted by event -> imperfect + preterite
time, age, weather, states in scene-setting -> usually imperfect
optional used-to emphasis -> soler in imperfect + infinitive
natural_examples: Cuando era nino, vivia cerca del centro.
Ayer llegue tarde a la reunion.
Eran las ocho y hacia frio.
Mi abuelo solia caminar todas las mananas.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Cuando era nino, jugaba en el parque. -> change subject to nosotros.
Base: Ayer hable con mi jefe. -> change to ella and use telefono movil.
Base: Estudiaba cuando empezo a llover. -> change subject to nosotros.
Base: Eran las ocho y hacia frio. -> change time to las seis and weather to heat.
Base: Mi abuelo iba al parque todos los dias. -> rewrite with soler in imperfect.
Base: Llegue tarde a la reunion. -> make it a question with tu.
Base: Viviamos en Mexico cuando naciste. -> change place to Colombia.
Base: Ella cantaba cuando entre. -> change interrupting verb to sali.
Base: Vi a Marta esta manana. -> change to plural nosotras and ayer.
Base: Trabajaba en una tienda los fines de semana. -> make it negative with yo.
Base: Ellos cenaban cuando sono el telefono. -> change activity to ver una pelicula.
Base: Tu nunca comias verduras cuando eras pequeno. -> change to ustedes.
Base: Fuimos al medico la semana pasada. -> change to singular yo.
Base: Se limpiaba la casa mientras yo cocinaba. -> change subject to ustedes.
Base: Mis padres viajaban mucho. -> add period cuando eran jovenes.

contrastive_discrimination.instructions: Choose the best option in each contrast.
prompts: Yesterday I read a book. (Ayer lei un libro. vs Ayer leia un libro.)
When I was little, I read every night. (Cuando era pequeno, leia cada noche. vs Cuando era pequeno, lei cada noche.)
She was studying when it started to rain. (Ella estudiaba cuando empezo a llover. vs Ella estudio cuando empezo a llover.)
The concert started at seven. (El concierto empezo a las siete. vs El concierto empezaba a las siete.)
We were cleaning while they cooked. (Nosotros limpiabamos mientras ellos cocinaban. vs Nosotros limpiamos mientras ellos cocinaron.)
He used to go to the gym on Mondays. (El iba al gimnasio los lunes. vs El fue al gimnasio los lunes.)
I saw Ana this morning. (Vi a Ana esta manana. vs Veia a Ana esta manana.)
It was three oclock and it was cold. (Eran las tres y hacia frio. vs Fueron las tres y hizo frio.)
My grandfather was very patient. (Mi abuelo era muy paciente. vs Mi abuelo fue muy paciente.)
When I entered, they were talking. (Cuando entre, ellos hablaban. vs Cuando entre, ellos hablaron.)

guided_personal_writing.instructions: Write one Spanish sentence for each specific meaning.
prompts: Write that yesterday you finished work late.
Write that when you were in college, you studied at night.
Write that your team was preparing a presentation when the internet failed.
Write that your boss arrived early and started the meeting immediately.
Write that when you were a child, your family visited your grandparents every Sunday.

Write that you were writing an email when a client called.

Write that last week you went to the doctor.

Write that your manager always told the truth in difficult meetings.

reverse_conceptual_expression.instructions: Write natural Spanish and choose tense by role, not word-for-word translation.
prompts_en: I was working when you called me.
Yesterday I sent the report and left the office.
When we lived in Mexico, summers were very hot.
At that moment, everyone was looking at the screen.
My sister used to wake up at five.
The meeting started, but I was still driving.
It was midnight and we were still talking.
I met my best friend in college.
As a child, I was afraid of dogs.
While they were discussing the budget, I took notes.

common_errors.mistake: Ayer hablaba con mi jefe for one finished call
common_errors.why_it_happens: Learner maps simple past directly to imperfect.

common_errors.mistake: Cuando era nino, jugue en el parque todos los dias
common_errors.why_it_happens: Habitual past gets treated as a single event.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Cuando era nino, jugaba en el parque todos los dias.

common_errors.mistake: Ella estudio cuando empezo a llover
common_errors.why_it_happens: Background action is marked as completed.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Ella estudiaba cuando empezo a llover.

common_errors.mistake: Fueron las ocho de la manana
common_errors.why_it_happens: Telling time in past is confused with completed action.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Eran las ocho de la manana.

common_errors.mistake: Hizo frio y llovio all afternoon for scene setting
common_errors.why_it_happens: Description is narrated as punctual events.

common_errors.mistake: Veia a Marta esta manana for one encounter
common_errors.why_it_happens: Specific completed sighting not marked with preterite.

common_errors.mistake: Mi abuelo fue al parque todos los dias
common_errors.why_it_happens: Repeated routine is not recognized as imperfect context.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Mi abuelo iba al parque todos los dias.

common_errors.mistake: Cuando entre, ellos hablaron for an ongoing action
Yo era al medico la semana pasada
common_errors.why_it_happens: Ir imperfect form iba is replaced by era from ser.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Yo fui al medico la semana pasada.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Double-marking tense with two conjugated verbs.
